description:
A visualization studio needs to convert a Cycles car scene to EEVEE for an interactive client presentation. The BMW demo scene is currently set up for Cycles rendering, which is far too slow for real-time use.

Your task:
1. Switch the render engine from Cycles to EEVEE.
2. Set EEVEE render samples to 64.
3. Set EEVEE viewport samples to 32.
4. Enable Ambient Occlusion (GTAO) and set its distance to approximately 1.0 m.
5. Enable Ray Tracing (or Screen Space Reflections) to ensure the metallic paint looks correct.
6. Set the render resolution to 1920x1080 at 100% scale.
7. Render the scene and save the image to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/eevee_render.png'.
8. Save the project file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/eevee_scene.blend'.

The scene file is already loaded in Blender: /home/ga/BlenderProjects/bmw_cycles.blend
